action.objective: Complete broad-search coverage of all legal White root moves at depth 4 before selecting a candidate.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search and broad_search_required is true. No prior analyses exist and no commit-ready moves are available, so I must first cover every legal root move. d6d7 (promoting pressure) and tactical Nxf6 ideas are the key candidates; the earlier d5d6 push was already played by Black's e7d8 response. Using half the node budget (3000) at target depth 4 to identify the best moves before single-candidate verification.
